_comment: Audit programme + findings. Added in Phase 9 as a dependency of the OPEN_CRIT_MAJOR_FINDINGS KPI and the Assurance Evidence Map (Phase 10); referenced by api-dashboard-summary's getAuditStatus() since Phase 4 but not formally schema'd until now. Audits.scope/criteria/planned_start/planned_end/actual_start/actual_end/created_at, AuditFindings.finding_number/evidence, and the AuditTeamMembers/AuditChecklistItems/AuditAssessments tables were added during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration (Phase C, audits module) — present on apps/web's audits.ts/audit_checklist_items/audit_assessments/audit_team_members Drizzle tables but missing from the original Phase 9 port.

columns.comment: Format AUD-{year}-{seq}; corresponds to apps/web's audits.audit_reference — named audit_number here since that predates this migration slice.
The row-scoping column — every query MUST run through propertyScopeClause().

self_assessment | department_inspection | internal_audit | legal_compliance_audit | iso45001_readiness | external_assurance — corrected during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration to match the actual audit_type enum in apps/web/src/db/schema/_enums.ts; the original Phase 9 comment listed a stale value set (internal | external | department_inspection | statutory).

Unused by the ported audits module (which reads/writes planned_start/planned_end below) — left in place as-is since it predates this migration slice and nothing else has been confirmed to depend on it.
Added during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration — present on apps/web's audits.scope, missing from the original Phase 9 port.
Added during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration — present on apps/web's audits.criteria, missing from the original Phase 9 port.
Added during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration — present on apps/web's audits.planned_start, missing from the original Phase 9 port.
Added during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration — present on apps/web's audits.planned_end, missing from the original Phase 9 port.
Added during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration — set when an audit advances planned -> in_progress; present on apps/web's audits.actual_start, missing from the original Phase 9 port.
Added during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration — set when an audit advances reporting -> closed; present on apps/web's audits.actual_end, missing from the original Phase 9 port.

planned | in_progress | reporting | closed — corrected during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration to include 'reporting' (the original Phase 9 comment omitted it, though apps/web's audit_status enum has always had it).
Added during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration — drives the AUD-{year}-{seq} sequence window and the audits list's default ordering, missing from the original Phase 9 port.
Added during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration — format FND-{year}-{seq}, present on apps/web's audit_findings.finding_number, missing from the original Phase 9 port.

critical_nc | major_nc | minor_nc | observation | ofi — corrected during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration to add 'ofi' (opportunity for improvement), which the original Phase 9 comment omitted though apps/web's finding_classification enum has always had it.
Added during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration — present on apps/web's audit_findings.evidence, missing from the original Phase 9 port.

tables.comment: Added during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration — ports apps/web's audit_team_members join table, missing from the original Phase 9 port. The lead auditor is inserted here with role_on_audit = 'lead_auditor' when an audit is created; additional members are added via addAuditTeamMemberAction.
Added during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration — ports apps/web's audit_checklist_items table, missing from the original Phase 9 port.

Added during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration — ports apps/web's audit_assessments table, missing from the original Phase 9 port. One row per (checklist item, dimension) scored during a checklist walkthrough — distinct from ControlAssessments in 06-controls-frameworks.json, which is the per-property control-maturity scoring layer feeding KPIs, not per-audit checklist scoring.
